in_marathi.name: Ishivanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva, God of Destruction
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishivanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishivanth is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishana' which means 'Lord' and 'Vanth' which means 'Going'. This name is used to signify the divine presence of Lord Shiva who is believed to be the destroyer of all evils and the creator of the universe. Ishivanth is a powerful name that is often chanted for protection, strength, and spiritual growth.
